scope: Quranic claims cross-referenced with selected canonical Gospel passage and textual-status notes

claims.statement: The Quran explicitly states that Allah gave Isa the Injil.
claims.note: This establishes the Quranic revelation claim; it does not identify Matthew/Mark/Luke/John as that Injil.

claims.statement: The Quran explicitly describes Jesus son of Mary as a messenger of Allah.
claims.note: The verse also warns against saying 'Three' and affirms one God.

claims.statement: Matthew 24:1-2 records a prediction attributed to Jesus concerning the temple's destruction.
claims.note: This is a Gospel text attributing the saying to Jesus; it is not by itself proof that the passage is the original Injil given to Isa.

comparison_rules: Do not equate the Quranic Injil with a modern Gospel without an identification argument.
Do not treat a Gospel passage as a Quranic revelation claim.
Keep theological claims separate from manuscript/history claims.
